name: Ancient City of Qalhat
description: Qalhat is a ruined port city on Oman's east coast, about 20 km north of Sur. Between the 11th and 15th centuries it flourished under the princes of Hormuz, and Marco Polo knew it as Calatu. You can walk among remains inside its double walls and see the cemeteries outside them, traces of a trading hub linking Arabia with East Africa, India, China and South-East Asia.
